updates.content:
`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` previously recorded the audit module's repository/service interfaces as `create`/`findById` and `record`/`getById` only. Phase 1 of this feature extends both interfaces (`findByEntity`, `getByEntity`), so the audit module's documented surface is updated in the same change — the doc is the contract the dependency check and later features read. The documented `findByEntity` signature was also corrected from the planned `(entityType, entityId, client?)` to the built `(entityType, entityId)`: the read path takes no `PoolClient`.

Phase 4 adds the tests that pin the built behaviour — `tests/unit/modules/audit/audit.repository.test.ts` (new) and the additive `GET /leaves/:id/history` block in `tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.routes.test.ts` — with no change under `src/`. The feature's four phases are now all delivered; the "Recommended phases" list above is updated accordingly.

**Known drift, not corrected by this phase:** `docs/DOMAIN.md`'s `audit` section still describes `Audit`/`AuditLog`/`AuditRecord`/`AuditServiceInterface` with `oldValues`/`newValues`/`performedBy`/`performedAt` fields. The built entity — and the shape the Phase 4 tests pin exactly — is `{ id, actorId, action, entityType, entityId, beforeState, afterState, occurredAt }`. The drift predates this phase and is recorded here so the next reader of DOMAIN.md is not misled.

**`docs/DOMAIN.md` `balance` heading repaired (follow-up to feature `93f4284a`).** The `## balance` heading had been collapsed onto the last row of the preceding `LeaveRequestQueryParams` table — the line read `| offset | number | false |## balance`. CommonMark does not parse a heading that abuts a table row, so the section was silently unaddressable: a heading-based lookup (the `readFile` `section` parameter, and any heading index built from the file) fell back to the preceding `leave` section instead of returning the balance body. The repair is whitespace-only: the row now terminates with a newline, a blank line follows, and `## balance` sits on its own line as a level-2 ATX heading, matching the file's other top-level sections (`## base`, `## leave`, `## employee`, `## policy`, `## notification`, `## audit`, `## validation`, `## system`, `## uptime`). No row, field, type, description, or section order changed, and the section's content (the `Balance` and `LeaveBalance` tables plus the `Represents leave balance data managed by the `balance` module...` description) is byte-identical; the section stays between `leave` and `employee`.

This is a formatting repair, not a reconciliation. The drift recorded above — the stale `audit` section, `LeaveRequest.leaveTypeId`/`approvedBy`/`approvedAt`, and `EmploymentStatus.INACTIVE` — is untouched and remains deliberately uncorrected, and no other known DOMAIN.md drift was addressed. No regression guard was added either: no markdown lint rule, heading-index assertion, or test now fails when a heading is collapsed onto a preceding line again — the repair is the line break alone. No file under `src/`, `web/`, `tests/`, `migrations/`, `seeds/`, or `scripts/` was touched by this change.
